author: Prachi Bhardwaj
title: Apple is stealing a great idea from Android as it gets ready to dramatically improve iPhone notifications (AAPL)
text: Apple is stealing a great idea from Android as it gets ready to dramatically improve iPhone notifications (AAPL) By Prachi Bhardwaj Jun 4, 2018, 3:30 pm 16 pts Apple is finally bringing "grouped notifications" to iPhones on the next generation of its operating system, iOS 12, which drops later this year. Grouped notifications save space on your screen by grouping together new alerts according to content and app; it's a capability that will sound familiar…
